name: Michal Niv
quote: A very diligent and creative team that always thinks outside the box to come up with ideas. We have achieved amazing results, and we look forward to continuing to work together.

name: Yali Harari
quote: Spark helped us build our user experience for our B2B platform. Amichai’s ability to translate our story and market requirements into the design was exceptional. Amichai always provided the added value with cutting-edge thinking coupled with a smart and clean suggestions that resonated with Innovesta's DNA.

name: Matan Holander
quote: Amichai is an excellent professional with a vast knowledge in digital design. It was a pleasure working with him on several UX and UI projects in the last years. He always provided the added value with a cutting-edge thinking, helping us to bring the most user intuitive products to market. Would recommend anyone to work with Amichai any time!

name: Sagi Kats
quote: At BrandTotal, we employed Spark to help us design 3 consumer apps. Amichai and his team took full ownership of the UX/UI and quickly became an integral part of BrandTotal. What I specifically appreciated was his relentless pursuit of performance optimization that led to applying routine design changes to meet business goals.

name: Rami Refaeli
quote: Amichai expertise coupled with his collaborative and innovative spirit made him the go-to expert for our most significant project. He single-handedly took our current solution experience from ordinary solution to a very unique and innovative experience by using forward-thinking strategies.

name: Daniel Leping
quote: Complex stuff can be done by anyone; only the true professional can make things simple. This certainly is about Amichai. He is a deep thinker. A trait you rarely encounter among designers. Any solution he offers is certainly not the first idea he could think of. His UX is thoroughly planned from the perspective of having the smallest number of usage barriers, being simple, lovable, complete and inclusive.
